description: This file contains static utility functions for file input/output operations within the PdfSharp library, including path normalization, temporary file management, and asset folder handling.

classes.name: IOUtility
classes.description: A static class providing utility functions for file and path operations, including path normalization, temporary file creation, and asset management.

methods.name: IsDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Checks if a character is a directory separator ('\' or '/').

methods.name: NormalizeDirectorySeparators
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path string.

methods.name: GetSolutionRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the current solution by locating a '.sln' file.

methods.name: GetAssetsPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the assets directory within the solution, optionally appending a relative path or filename.

methods.name: GetTempPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the temporary directory, optionally appending a relative directory.

methods.name: GetViewerWatchDirectory
methods.description: Returns the hard-coded directory path for the viewer watch directory based on OS.

methods.name: GetTempFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary filename with a specific pattern.

methods.name: GetTempFullFileName
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a full path, optionally including sub-paths, and returns its name.

methods.name: FindLatestTempFile
methods.description: Finds the most recently modified temporary file matching a pattern in a directory, optionally recursive.

methods.name: EnsureAssets
methods.description: Ensures the assets folder exists and contains specific files or directories.

methods.name: EnsureAssetsVersion
methods.description: Checks that the assets folder's version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: GetCachedWebFile
methods.description: Downloads and caches a web file in the assets folder if not already cached.
